clear_all.doc: Clear MFS file notifications and chat message notifications across multiple hubs for the authenticated user. Iterates over the provided nodes map calling stored procedure mfs_clear_notifications per hub, then iterates over the messages map calling stored procedure channel_clear_notifications per hub. Hubs with no db_name are silently skipped.

nodes.description: Map of hub_id to array of MFS node IDs whose file notifications should be cleared. Keys are hub IDs, values are arrays of node identifiers to reset.

messages.description: Map of hub_id to any value indicating that chat message notifications should be cleared for that hub. Keys are hub IDs. The value is not used directly; only the hub key is needed to identify which hubs to clear.

returns.description: The nodes map echoed back as confirmation of which MFS node notifications were processed

nodes.description: The original nodes input map returned as the response list, keyed by hub_id

errors.message: nodes parameter is required but was not provided
messages parameter is required but was not provided
Failed to clear notifications via stored procedure mfs_clear_notifications or channel_clear_notifications
